title: 皐月賞の後に・汝が吼えるは

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After taking the Satsuki Sho by storm, Yaeno Muteki lets out a triumphant roar. Then, announcing her intention to win the Japanese Derby, she showcases an intense desire for the second crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Mejiro Ardan is disappointed with her loss at the Satsuki Sho, her steady strides away from the track are a sure sign of her growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We vow to capitalize on what we've learned today to ensure promising results at both the Aoba Sho and the Japanese Derby to follow.
